# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 14 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 1 token; Size — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #fffdf8);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #0e3b43);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #fffdf8;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #fffdf8 | #0e3b43 | Cards, panels, inputs and the exam sheet. |
| `--paper` | #f6f3ec | #f6f3ec | Brand Paper. The book in the mark, light grounds, Ink-on-Paper print. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 64px/68px Fraunces, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
/* a web page, not a slide: the style’s optical size */
font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 96;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-headline-xl); letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 96;
font-family: var(--font-serif);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing, optical size | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `headline-xl` | `.headline-xl`, `--text-headline-xl` | 64px / 68px, letter-spacing -0.02em, optical size 96 | 600 | `serif` | Hero headlines on the site and campaign posters. One per page. |
| `headline-l` | `.headline-l`, `--text-headline-l` | 44px / 50px, letter-spacing -0.015em, optical size 72 | 560 | `serif` | Section openers, social post headlines. Mobile hero size. |
| `title-1` | `.title-1`, `--text-title-1` | 32px / 40px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 650 | `sans` | Screen titles. |

| `title-3` | `.title-3`, `--text-title-3` | 19px / 26px | 600 | `sans` | Sub-sections, dialog titles. |
| `body-l` | `.body-l`, `--text-body-l` | 18px / 28px | 400 | `sans` | Lead paragraphs, exam instructions. |

| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 13px / 16px, letter-spacing 0.06em | 650 | `sans` | Eyebrows and tags, set in capitals. |
| `score` | `.score`, `--text-score` | 48px / 48px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 700 | `sans` | The reading in the exam's own scale. Tabular figures. |

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/Figtree-Variable.woff2`, `fonts/Figtree-Italic-Variable.woff2` and `fonts/Fraunces-Variable.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/Figtree-Variable.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/Figtree-Variable.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Figtree | `fonts/Figtree-Variable.woff2` (weight 300 900) | `read fonts/Figtree-Variable.woff2` | `var(--font-sans)` | `figtree` |
| Fraunces | `fonts/Fraunces-Variable.woff2` (weight 100 900) | `read fonts/Fraunces-Variable.woff2` | `var(--font-serif)` | `fraunces` |

Every face: `fonts/Figtree-Variable.woff2` (Figtree, 300 900), `fonts/Figtree-Italic-Variable.woff2` (Figtree, 300 900, italic), `fonts/Fraunces-Variable.woff2` (Fraunces, 100 900).

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon to label gap. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Tight groups: chips, inline controls. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Form field gaps, list rows. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Card padding on mobile, minimum side gutter. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Card padding on tablet and desktop, gaps between cards. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Between sections inside a screen. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Between page sections on mobile. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Between page sections on desktop. |
